EmailTemplate.subject: SPOTLIGHT: Refund Bundling
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
In light of the recent COVID-19 pandemic, we realize the need for your institution to process a variety of refunds. To help you with these efforts and minimize any processing delays, we wanted to send along a video that outlines refund bundling.
The bundle feature in our new dashboard <[[https://dashboard-new.flywire.com/refunds?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> was designed to specifically help our clients create multiple refunds from a single file, saving you time and money. Check out this short 45-second video <[[https://youtu.be/-vhMeRmfrBE?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> to see it in action!
In addition, below are a few critical steps that will enable us to more efficiently match and process your refunds:
- To speed up refunds, always send the exact amount you initiated from the dashboard.
- Always use the Return ID (for single refunds) and the Bundle ID (for bundle refunds) as the remittance reference on your transfer so Flywire can quickly identify your incoming return.
- Send the funds to Flywire via electronic transfer as soon as possible after refund initiation to ensure swift payment processing back to the originating account.
Please note that while following the above steps will help us process your refunds, overall processing times may be impacted due to the changing landscape of current events. We would also like to remind you that in order to mitigate fraud and money-laundering risk, all payments received via Flywire must also be refunded to Flywire.
<[[https://youtu.be/-vhMeRmfrBE?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
Note: Initiating refunds is a user permission that can be granted to you by your institution’s Flywire Admin. See here <[[https://help.client.flywire.com/hc/en-us/articles/360010827459-User-Management-Rights-Portal-Permissions]]> for how to enable refunds access for a user in the new dashboard.
If you have questions or need assistance, simply log into our Help Center <[[https://help.client.flywire.com/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> for additional resources, or contact your Relationship Manager.
